item.title: Dear Hendrix
item.description: There is nothing like the love you get from a grandparent. by Eva Walker Dear Hendrix, I was one of the lucky ones. Growing up, my grandparents were in my life in a major way, and I don't know where I would be today without them. It's a funny thing—so often we're taught that success means to move away from your family and start your own life, your own family.
